description.value: A bed and breakfast perched on Thacker Mountain with panoramic views of the Cascade Mountains and the town of Hope below. The property overlooks Hope Golf and Country Club and is about a 30-minute walk or 5-minute drive from downtown Hope. Each room includes a full hot or continental breakfast and a private deck.

address.value: 21623 Thacker Mountain Road, Hope, BC, V0X 1L1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is High Hopes Bed & Breakfast, an active B&B on Thacker Mountain overlooking Hope, BC. OSM's 'name' field contains only the street address, not the business name — the website clearly identifies it as 'High Hopes Bed & Breakfast'. Wi-Fi is confirmed both by OSM tag (internet_access=wlan) and website room listings ('Fast Wifi'). The Golf Club restaurant is described as nearby and 'open to the public', confirming nearby evening food. No bike storage, cycling infrastructure, or bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
